svg.title: Chart B · Capability diffusion
svg.desc: Solid: capability demonstrated (tested or used). Hatched: developing or latent. Stack height counts state-capability pairs (a state with two capabilities counts twice). Decades before 2020 are reconstructed by the page builder, not assessed by SWF.
Stacked step area of the number of states holding each counterspace capability per decade, zero baseline. See the data table for exact counts.

text.tspan: Electronic warfare drives most of the crowding: 12 states in the 2020s.
Demonstrated destructive DA-ASAT capability has stayed at four states: US, China, USSR/Russia, India.

svg.text: Solid: capability demonstrated (tested or used). Hatched: developing or latent. Stack height counts state-capability pairs (a state with two capabilities counts twice). Decades before 2020 are reconstructed by the
page builder, not assessed by SWF.

Source: Secure World Foundation, Global Counterspace Capabilities: An Open Source Assessment (9th ed., Apr. 2026) and the primary sources cited in the ledger. Data as of SWF 9th ed., Apr. 2026. Companion to
Space Security Law: Governance Beyond the Atmosphere.
